raw_translation: Wannan shi ne wani simulator na yanayi mai ƙarancin girma ga adadin masu canji masu zaman kansu. Waɗannan rabawa da shigarwa su ne zarge-zarge da kake zaɓa; babu wata dangantaka, formula na ɗabi'a, hasashen ko tabbaci. Wani ƙwai mai daidaitawa yana samar da irin wannan tafiyar. Parameters na ɗabi'a dole ne su yi amfani da wata dama. Aikin ƙididdiga yana zaune a cikin wannan taswirar.
source: This is a small scenario simulator for sums of independent scalar variables. The distributions and inputs are assumptions you choose; there are no correlations, custom formulas, forecasts or guarantees. A fixed seed reproduces the same run. Decimal parameters must use a dot. Computation stays in this browser.
translation: Wannan shi ne wani simulator na yanayi mai ƙarancin girma ga adadin masu canji masu zaman kansu.
